# Ngenix
> NGENIX provides cloud infrastructure, CDN, DDoS protection, DNS, and managed hosting services for businesses.

This site covers NGENIX products, infrastructure services, company information, and customer resources for content delivery, security, and hosting.

## Products
- [CDN](https://ngenix.net/en/products/cdn/): Content delivery network service for accelerating websites and applications.
- [DDoS Protection](https://ngenix.net/en/products/ddos-protection/): Network and application-layer protection against distributed denial-of-service attacks.
- [DNS Hosting](https://ngenix.net/en/products/dns-hosting/): Managed authoritative DNS service for reliable domain resolution.
- [Cloud](https://ngenix.net/en/products/cloud/): Cloud infrastructure platform for deploying and scaling workloads.
- [Storage](https://ngenix.net/en/products/storage/): Object and related storage services for application and content data.
- [Streaming](https://ngenix.net/en/products/streaming/): Media delivery services for online video and streaming workloads.

## Solutions
- [E-commerce](https://ngenix.net/en/solutions/e-commerce/): Performance and security solutions tailored for online retail platforms.
- [Media](https://ngenix.net/en/solutions/media/): Delivery and protection services for publishers and media platforms.
- [Gaming](https://ngenix.net/en/solutions/gaming/): Low-latency infrastructure and protection for online game services.
- [Fintech](https://ngenix.net/en/solutions/fintech/): Secure and resilient infrastructure for financial technology applications.
- [Enterprise](https://ngenix.net/en/solutions/enterprise/): Scalable infrastructure offerings for large organizations and complex workloads.

## Cloud Services
- [Virtual Machines](https://ngenix.net/en/products/cloud/): Compute resources for running applications in the cloud environment.
- [Kubernetes](https://ngenix.net/en/products/cloud/): Container orchestration support within the cloud platform.
- [Networking](https://ngenix.net/en/products/cloud/): Cloud networking capabilities for connecting and isolating workloads.
- [Load Balancing](https://ngenix.net/en/products/cloud/): Traffic distribution features for highly available application architectures.
- [Snapshots and Backups](https://ngenix.net/en/products/cloud/): Data protection capabilities for cloud-hosted infrastructure.

## Security
- [DDoS Protection](https://ngenix.net/en/products/ddos-protection/): Mitigates volumetric and application-layer denial-of-service attacks.
- [Web Application Firewall](https://ngenix.net/en/products/ddos-protection/): Application protection capabilities for filtering malicious web traffic.
- [DNS Security](https://ngenix.net/en/products/dns-hosting/): Resilient DNS hosting for availability and domain resolution reliability.
- [Traffic Filtering](https://ngenix.net/en/products/ddos-protection/): Filtering and scrubbing services for suspicious inbound traffic.
